summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of David Sturgeon as Chief Financial Officer effective August 1, 2026. This is a routine management change and not an abrupt or forced departure. The filing includes a press release detailing Mr. Sturgeon's background, including his experience as a CFO at Nasdaq-listed companies. No financial terms, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are mentioned. The event is a standard executive appointment, which does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories. The filing serves as a current report on Form 6-K, consistent with Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, and lacks any triggering event for special-situation classification.
